# Game Idea: *Orbit Escape*

- **Genre**: Action / Arcade
- **Platform**: HTML5 Canvas (pure JavaScript)
- **Core mechanic**: The player controls a small ship that rotates around a central planet using left/right arrow keys. The ship constantly thrusts outward; the player must time thrusts to avoid incoming asteroids that spawn from the edge of the canvas and move toward the planet.
- **Goal**: Survive as long as possible while collecting floating fuel pickups to extend playtime.
- **Lose condition**: The game ends when the ship collides with an asteroid or runs out of fuel.
- **Visuals**: Simple vector shapes – a circle for the planet, a triangle for the ship, and small circles for asteroids.
- **Scoring**: Time survived (seconds) and number of fuel pickups collected.

*This concept can be built with a single HTML file using the Canvas API, requestAnimationFrame loop, and basic physics.*

1: // Orbit Escape – minimal implementation
2: // Assumes an HTML <canvas id="game"></canvas> is present.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Full‑window canvas and starfield background
8:   const stars = [];
9:   for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
10:     stars.push({
11:       x: Math.random() * window.innerWidth,
12:       y: Math.random() * window.innerHeight,
13:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
14:     });
15:   }
16:   const resize = () => {
17:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
18:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
19:     // centre planet
20:     planet.x = canvas.width / 2;
21:     planet.y = canvas.height / 2;
22:     // reposition stars on resize
23:     stars.forEach(s => {
24:       s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
25:       s.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
26:     });
27:   };
28:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
29:   resize();
30: 
31:   const planet = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2, r: 40 };
32:   let ship = {
33:     angle: 0, // radians
34:     radius: planet.r + 30,
35:     angularVel: 0,
36:     radialVel: 0,
37:     size: 12,
38:     fuel: 100,
39:   };
40:   const asteroids = [];
41:   const pickups = [];
42:   let score = 0;
43:   let gameOver = false;
44:   let lastSpawn = 0;
45:   let lastPickup = 0;
46: 
47:   const keys = {};
48:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
49:     keys[e.key] = true;
50:     if (e.key === ' ') {
51:       // Play thrust sound on space press
52:       playTone(300, 0.08);
53:     }
54:   });
55:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
56: 
57:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
58:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
59:     let x, y, vx, vy;
60:     const speed = 1.5 + Math.random();
61:     const margin = 20;
62:     if (edge === 0) { // top
63:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
64:       y = -margin;
65:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
66:       x = canvas.width + margin;
67:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
68:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
69:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
70:       y = canvas.height + margin;
71:     } else { // left
72:       x = -margin;
73:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
74:     }
75:     const dx = planet.x - x;
76:     const dy = planet.y - y;
77:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
78:     vx = (dx / len) * speed;
79:     vy = (dy / len) * speed;
80:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 8 + Math.random() * 6 });
81:   };
82: 
83:   const spawnPickup = () => {
84:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
85:     const radius = planet.r + 80 + Math.random() * 120;
86:     const x = planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
87:     const y = planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
88:     pickups.push({ x, y, r: 6, collected: false });
89:   };
90: 
91:   const update = dt => {
92:     if (gameOver) return;
93:     // Controls
94:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angularVel -= 0.0015 * dt;
95:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angularVel += 0.0015 * dt;
96:     // Constant outward thrust
97:     ship.radialVel += 0.0002 * dt;
98:     // Optional extra thrust with Space
99:     if (keys[' ']) ship.radialVel += 0.0005 * dt;
100:     // Apply velocities
101:     ship.angle += ship.angularVel * dt;
102:     ship.radius += ship.radialVel * dt;
103:     // Dampen velocities
104:     ship.angularVel *= 0.99;
105:     ship.radialVel *= 0.99;
106:     // Keep within bounds
107:     const maxR = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2 - 20;
108:     if (ship.radius > maxR) ship.radius = maxR;
109:     if (ship.radius < planet.r + 10) ship.radius = planet.r + 10;
110:     // Update ship position
111:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
112:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
113:     // Asteroids
114:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
115:       const a = asteroids[i];
116:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
117:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
118:       // collision with ship
119:       const d = Math.hypot(a.x - sx, a.y - sy);
120: if (d < a.r + ship.size) {
121:           // Play collision sound
122:           playTone(100, 0.3);
123:           gameOver = true;
124:         }
125:       // remove if passed planet
126:       const dp = Math.hypot(a.x - planet.x, a.y - planet.y);
127:       if (dp < planet.r) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
128:     }
129:     // Pickups
130:     for (let i = pickups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
131:       const p = pickups[i];
132:       const d = Math.hypot(p.x - sx, p.y - sy);
133: if (d < p.r + ship.size) {
134:           // Play pickup sound
135:           playTone(600, 0.1);
136:           ship.fuel = Math.min(ship.fuel + 20, 200);
137:           pickups.splice(i, 1);
138:           score++;
139:         }
140:     }
141:     // Spawn asteroids every ~2 seconds
142:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > 2000) {
143:       spawnAsteroid();
144:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
145:     }
146:     // Spawn pickups every ~7 seconds
147:     if (performance.now() - lastPickup > 7000) {
148:       spawnPickup();
149:       lastPickup = performance.now();
150:     }
151:     // Decrease fuel over time
152:     ship.fuel -= 0.01 * dt;
153:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
154:     // Score based on time
155:     score = Math.floor(performance.now() / 1000);
156:   };
157: 
158:   const draw = () => {
159:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
160:     // Starfield background
161:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
162:     stars.forEach(s => {
163:       ctx.beginPath();
164:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
165:       ctx.fill();
166:     });
167:     // Planet with gradient
168:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
169:       planet.x,
170:       planet.y,
171:       planet.r * 0.2,
172:       planet.x,
173:       planet.y,
174:       planet.r
175:     );
176:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4c8');
177:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2a5');
178:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
179:     ctx.beginPath();
180:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
181:     ctx.fill();
182:     // Ship
183:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
184:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
185:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
186:     ctx.save();
187:     ctx.translate(sx, sy);
188:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle + Math.PI / 2);
189:     // Ship gradient
190:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ship.size, 0, ship.size);
191:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
192:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#666');
193:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
194:     ctx.beginPath();
195:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.size);
196:     ctx.lineTo(ship.size / 2, ship.size);
197:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size / 2, ship.size);
198:     ctx.closePath();
199:     ctx.fill();
200:     ctx.restore();
201:     // Asteroids
202:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
203:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
204:         a.x,
205:         a.y,
206:         a.r * 0.2,
207:         a.x,
208:         a.y,
209:         a.r
210:       );
211:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f88');
212:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#a33');
213:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
214:       ctx.beginPath();
215:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
216:       ctx.fill();
217:     });
218:     // Pickups
219:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
220:     pickups.forEach(p => {
221:       ctx.beginPath();
222:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
223:       ctx.fill();
224:     });
225:     // HUD
226:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
227:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
228:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
229:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.max(0, Math.floor(ship.fuel))}`, 10, 40);
230:     if (gameOver) {
231:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
232:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
233:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
234:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
235:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
236:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
237:     }
238:   };
239: 
240:   let last = performance.now();
241:   // Audio setup
242:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
243:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
244:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
245:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
246:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
247:     osc.type = 'sine';
248:     osc.connect(gain);
249:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
250:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
251:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
252:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
253:     osc.start();
254:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
255:   };
256:   const loop = () => {
257:     const now = performance.now();
258:     const dt = now - last;
259:     last = now;
260:     update(dt);
261:     draw();
262:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
263:   };
264:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
265: })();
